elaine: Quick sync — we need a tight, actionable gating matrix for the upcoming launch. SLA targets, runbooks, docs, observability, and any billing/quoting edge cases. Can owners ack and call out gaps? :eyes:

raj: Ack. Eng will own latency SLOs + canaries. Current p99 baseline on canary is ~230ms for 512-token requests. I'll propose final targets below.

tomas: Monitoring + alerts here. I'll wire a dedicated dashboard and add two synthetic checks (small prompt + long streaming prompt). Need agreement on alert thresholds.

maria: Support status: runbook draft is 70% — triage steps included, but escalation matrix needs on-call routing + contact emails. Also need example transcripts for training L1.

elaine: Great. Raj — can you paste the proposed SLO block we should approve? Keep it compact so legal/commercial can reference.

raj: Putting a minimal SLO snippet here for the gating doc:

```
service: inference-api
slo:
  - name: latency-p50
    target: 50ms
  - name: latency-p95
    target: 120ms
  - name: latency-p99
    target: 250ms
  - name: availability
    target: 99.9%
```

raj: Notes: p99 250ms is aggressive but achievable with current model placement + KV cache. If we can't hit p99 for 4k tokens, we should document fallback variants (quantized model) and ensure automatic routing.

tomas: For alerts, I suggest:
- page if availability < 99% over 5m
- page if p99 > 350ms for 10m
- page if error-rate > 0.5% for 5m
